title: the story so far, painted by gode
layout_fix: v2 (2026-11-19 20:30 ET): unpublished placement bugfix. Vertex dots and ink marks were drawn with iso.px (unscaled) on the SS=2 canvas, so they appeared as a cluster of circles with red/green ink marks outside the building, to the top-left of ROOF/UPPER; they are now drawn with iso.p (scaled) and every x,z is clamped inside its floor plate. The huge orange GROUND fan was pepu.setmany() (73 edges, method outline #d9741a) plus ronke.hail() (84), genuine hubs whose linear curve offsets (0.10*((k+1)//2)) spread across the floor; those bundles now use capped slight offsets, thinner strokes and faded colour. v1 positions were rewritten because they were never published.

schema.vertices: map of vertex id → {id, kind (object|method), floor, x,y,z (iso hall, clamped inside the floor plate), px,py (screen), location, source}
schema.edges: list of fired-call edges, one per argument: {from, to, from_xyz, to_xyz (x,y,z + px,py), index (global call order), job, run, call, method, hex (agenda), outline (method), label}
schema.layout: vertices always sit inside the hall footprint of their floor; heavy (from,to) pairs are bundled (capped curve offset, thinner faded stroke)
